notes: §2002:11.6.2 SR7 constrains only the shape: one USING parameter and no RETURNING phrase. A SET PROPERTY method with that shape is accepted and runs as the set property method (§2002:11.6.3 GR7, 'BAL=0084'). One whose USING item is ACTIVE-CLASS is also accepted, since 2002 has no such ban (§2002:13.16.58.2 SR15). One with a RETURNING phrase and no USING is refused with COBOL2790.
